note: The textbook case, and the only core-ICP prospect in this batch. Owns his own company acquiring oil and gas mineral rights and states he could retire now — the 'already good in their life, they're successful, they own their own business' half of the stated definition. Income is unambiguous: he guessed $20,000 before hearing the price and never raised a money objection. Training is the one domain he has let slide while diet, sleep and cardiovascular health are actively managed, which is precisely 'health is the thing that has more so been neglected'. And he is emphatically good-to-great rather than rescue — a former Division 1 athlete at 16-18% body fat wanting 10%, which he and the rep together framed as retuning an athlete who is already there. He is the inverse of the excluded profile in every respect. Worth recording for the rollup: this is the one call in twelve that closed, and it is the one prospect who matched every stated criterion, which is a data point on the ICP's predictive value rather than merely its aspiration. The criterion the ICP still lacks is clinical — an unrepaired complete PCL tear and a grade 3 AC separation would not be caught by any of the five tests.
